name: Ultraviolet
source:
Luka has it all; charisma, talent, money and more friends that he can remember the name of, but a hook up with a vampire makes him lose everything he loved. Will he be able to win the band battle and recover his perfect life?

[From [url=https://veracity.itch.io/ultraviolet]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
卢卡拥有一切；魅力、才华、金钱和更多他能记住名字的朋友，但与吸血鬼的勾搭让他失去了他所爱的一切。他能否赢得乐队之战，恢复完美生活呢？

[来自[url=https://veracity.itch.io/ultraviolet]itch.io[/url]]
